Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: aerial, facing street, fov 90
- highway road, 1-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: right; parking: none
- commercial building at center, 1 story, wood, brick, metal, pitched roof, shallow setback
- utilities: power lines, utility poles
- landscape: bare soil
- immutable elements: mountain
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1975
Post-Vietnam, oil crisis era. A full-service neighborhood gas station in 1975 — uniformed attendants pump the gas, check the oil, and wipe the windshield.

CONDITION: busy — customers present, high activity, all pumps in use

PERIOD DETAILS
- mechanical analog pumps with rotating numeral dials and glass-and-chrome detailing
- porcelain-enamel brand signs on the building fascia
- price sign showing gas around $0.57
- main sign: "Shell" branded gas station — Shell pole sign with price display and Shell colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: 'WE HONOR BANKAMERICARD', 'MOTOR OIL 55¢ QT'
- a water can and towel bucket on the pump island
- a stack of used tires beside the service bay
Typography: bold sans-serif, slab serif, occasional script.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 14 people TOTAL: 6 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 5 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 3 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a customer paying the attendant cash through the car window
- a mechanic in coveralls rolling a tire toward the service bay
- a shopkeeper in an apron by his doorway
Clothing: men in plaid patterns, bell bottoms; women in peasant blouses, wide leg pants. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 3 period vehicles, all different:
- 1975-1983 Volkswagen Rabbit — small boxy hatchback, new for 1975
- 1974-1978 Ford Mustang II — smaller downsized pony car
- 1973-1979 Ford F-100 — square body, chrome grille
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1975.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: the first two parked on the RIGHT side; the rest parked on the LEFT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, no rumble strips
- utilities: overhead power lines everywhere, wooden utility poles standard

TREES
- deciduous tree at left: very young sapling
- deciduous tree at right: very young sapling
- deciduous tree at background: very young sapling
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
STRICTLY BLACK AND WHITE — true monochrome archival photograph, zero color anywhere.
Grain: visible fine grain. Style: documentary, natural light.
Photorealistic, like a preserved newspaper-archive frame; slight period-lens softness, not digitally sharp.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1975-1983 Volkswagen Rabbit — small boxy hatchback, new for 1975
1974-1978 Ford Mustang II — smaller downsized pony car
1973-1979 Ford F-100 — square body, chrome grille
